lines.zh: 我每摆一次尾，海就退开一段。
lines.en: Each sweep of my tail pushes the sea aside.

lines.zh: 我从深处的暗里升起来，很慢。
lines.en: I rise out of the deep dark, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我的身长让浅湾显得可笑。
lines.en: My length makes the shallows look absurd.

lines.zh: 我游过沉船，它在我背下像块石头。
lines.en: I pass a wreck; it looks like a stone beneath me.

lines.zh: 水压在我身上，我一点也不在意。
lines.en: The water presses on me; I do not care at all.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟走，那里才容得下我。
lines.en: I travel the trench; only there is room for me.

lines.zh: 巨大的影子先到，我才到。
lines.en: My vast shadow arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 我穿过鲸群，它们给我让路。
lines.en: I pass through a pod of whales; they make way.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫过海底，扬起沙幕。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the seafloor and raises a curtain of sand.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地走，因为我够大。
lines.en: I move slowly, because I am big enough.

lines.zh: 从水面看，我只是一个黑影。
lines.en: From the surface, I am only a dark shape.

lines.zh: 我不需要快，猎物会自己停下。
lines.en: I need no speed; my prey stops on its own.

lines.zh: 海底的岩脊被我撞开一道口子。
lines.en: The seafloor ridge splits where I strike it.

lines.zh: 我巡这片海，已经很多年了。
lines.en: I have patrolled this sea for many years.

lines.zh: 我张口换气，水从鳃边冲出去。
lines.en: I open my mouth to breathe and water rushes past my gills.

lines.zh: 船底的声音传到深处，我抬头。
lines.en: A hull's sound reaches the deep, and I look up.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁盘转，等潮水退。
lines.en: I circle the reef and wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 这一片浅滩，还不够我翻身。
lines.en: This shallow shelf is not wide enough to turn in.

lines.zh: 我悬在深处，像一座会动的小山。
lines.en: I hang in the depths like a moving hill.

lines.zh: 张嘴的时候，水自己流进来。
lines.en: When I open my mouth, the water enters by itself.

lines.zh: 我嘴里那排牙，比人的手掌还宽。
lines.en: The teeth in my jaw are wider than a human palm.

lines.zh: 深海的暗里，我什么也不用看。
lines.en: In the dark of the deep, I need see nothing.

lines.zh: 我掉过很多牙，海底到处都是。
lines.en: I have shed many teeth; they litter the seabed.

lines.zh: 一条鲸鱼在我上方游过，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: A whale passes overhead; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我不饿的时候，连水都懒得推。
lines.en: When not hungry, I cannot be bothered to push water.

lines.zh: 骨头里的旧伤在下雨前会响。
lines.en: Old scars in my bones ache before rain.

lines.zh: 这片海比岸上的世界老。
lines.en: This sea is older than the world on shore.

lines.zh: 我闭上嘴，海水安静下来。
lines.en: I close my jaw and the sea grows quiet.

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，普通的牙咬不动。
lines.en: My hide is thick; ordinary teeth cannot pierce it.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶经过的鱼群，数不清。
lines.en: I count the schools passing above; I lose count.

lines.zh: 我把巨齿咬得咔咔响。
lines.en: I grind my giant teeth.

lines.zh: 沉船的钟在海里响了一声。
lines.en: A wreck's bell rings once in the sea.

lines.zh: 你这么小，我要凑近才看得清。
lines.en: You are so small I must come close to see clearly.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你整颗头还大。
lines.en: My eye is larger than your entire head.

lines.zh: 你站在礁石上，我露出水面。
lines.en: You stand on the reef; I break the surface.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一粒沙。
lines.en: I look at you the way one looks at a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，照不全我。
lines.en: You raise a torch; it cannot light all of me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转过来，水被挤开。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and the water is displaced.

lines.zh: 你后退一步，我前进一寸。
lines.en: You step back; I advance an inch.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的血腥味了。
lines.en: I smell the blood on you now.

lines.zh: 我的黑眼珠一动不动。
lines.en: My black eye does not move at all.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我看见你的喉咙。
lines.en: You look up; I see your throat.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的皮上，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: Your blade leaves only a white scratch on my hide.

lines.zh: 这么小的伤口，我几百年来没数过。
lines.en: Such small wounds—I have not counted them in centuries.

lines.zh: 我流血了，海也跟着变暗。
lines.en: I bleed, and the sea darkens with me.

lines.zh: 疼让我转过身来，整片水都动了。
lines.en: Pain turns me around, and all the water moves.

lines.zh: 你不该让我注意到你。
lines.en: You should not have made me notice you.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，海底的石缝都在响。
lines.en: I bellow, and the seabed cracks echo it.

lines.zh: 我把伤口撞向礁石，蹭掉你的箭。
lines.en: I scrape the wound on a reef to shed your arrow.

lines.zh: 皮破了，肉还厚着呢。
lines.en: The hide is cut; the flesh is still thick.

lines.zh: 我第一次觉得这片海有点窄。
lines.en: For the first time this sea feels narrow.

lines.zh: 我退了一段，又转回来。
lines.en: I back off a stretch, then turn back.

lines.zh: 整头牛的重量，也填不满我。
lines.en: A whole cow would not fill me.

lines.zh: 你扔下的肉太小，可我还是来了。
lines.en: The meat you drop is tiny, yet I come.

lines.zh: 血味在海里能传很远。
lines.en: Blood in the sea carries a long way.

lines.zh: 我咬住诱饵，连绳子一起。
lines.en: I take the bait, rope and all.

lines.zh: 你把鱼挂在钩上，我看穿了。
lines.en: You hang a fish on a hook; I see through it.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是因为你在流血。
lines.en: I come closer because you are bleeding.

lines.zh: 我不急，你跑不出这片海。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; you cannot leave this sea.

lines.zh: 食物越多，我张嘴越慢。
lines.en: The more food there is, the slower I open.

lines.zh: 你把手伸出来，我以为是食物。
lines.en: You hold out your hand; I take it for food.

lines.zh: 这点分量，只够塞我的牙缝。
lines.en: That much would only fill the gaps in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: You crash into me as into a wall.

lines.zh: 我稍微一侧，你就被推开了。
lines.en: I lean slightly, and you are pushed aside.

lines.zh: 我的皮比船板还粗。
lines.en: My hide is coarser than a ship's planks.

lines.zh: 你撞在我鳍上，鳍没有动。
lines.en: You strike my fin; the fin does not move.

lines.zh: 我一转身，整片水都跟着转。
lines.en: I turn, and all the water turns with me.

lines.zh: 你被弹开，落在几丈外的水里。
lines.en: You bounce off and land several fathoms away.

lines.zh: 我不躲，没什么值得我躲。
lines.en: I do not dodge; nothing is worth dodging.

lines.zh: 你踩在我背上，像踩在礁石上。
lines.en: You step on my back as on a reef.

lines.zh: 碰撞的声音在水下很闷。
lines.en: The sound of impact is muffled underwater.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，只是顺路。
lines.en: I shove you aside; I was passing anyway.

lines.zh: 它从更深的沟里上来，和我一样大。
lines.en: It rises from a deeper trench, as large as I am.

lines.zh: 我们并排游了很远，没有说话。
lines.en: We swim side by side a long way, saying nothing.

lines.zh: 两颗巨大的心脏，节奏慢慢对上。
lines.en: Two enormous hearts slowly find the same rhythm.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的鳍，只是轻轻含着。
lines.en: I take its fin in my jaws, only holding lightly.

lines.zh: 深海里没有季节，我们靠水温。
lines.en: The deep has no seasons; we go by water temperature.

lines.zh: 它的旧疤和我的旧疤对得上。
lines.en: Its old scars match my own.

lines.zh: 我们绕了三圈，海水被推到岸上。
lines.en: We circle three times, and the sea is pushed ashore.

lines.zh: 幼崽会长到和我一样大。
lines.en: The young will grow as large as I am.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各自沉回暗里。
lines.en: We part and each sinks back into the dark.

lines.zh: 这一片海，容得下我们两个。
lines.en: This sea has room for both of us.

lines.zh: 我咬住箱子，木头发出一声脆响。
lines.en: I bite the crate; the wood snaps sharply.

lines.zh: 铁锚被我一口咬弯了。
lines.en: I bite an anchor and bend it.

lines.zh: 我没有手，掉的东西只能沉。
lines.en: I have no hands; dropped things can only sink.

lines.zh: 我吞下过一整块船板。
lines.en: I have swallowed a whole plank of a ship.

lines.zh: 牙齿会掉，掉在沙上就是石头。
lines.en: My teeth fall out; on sand they become stones.

lines.zh: 那东西太小，我根本咬不住。
lines.en: That thing is too small for me to grip.

lines.zh: 我在沙里翻找自己的旧牙。
lines.en: I sift the sand for my own old teeth.

lines.zh: 渔网缠上来，我一口就咬断了。
lines.en: A net tangles on me; one bite cuts it.

lines.zh: 沉船里的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: The things inside wrecks do not interest me.

lines.zh: 我拱起一堆沙，把东西埋了。
lines.en: I push up a heap of sand and bury it.

lines.zh: 我选定你了，因为你最吵。
lines.en: I have chosen you because you are loudest.

lines.zh: 整片海只有你在动，目标就是你。
lines.en: Only you move in this whole sea; you are the target.

lines.zh: 鲸鱼太远，你正好在嘴边。
lines.en: The whale is too far; you are right at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的牙一排排立起来。
lines.en: My teeth stand up in rows.

lines.zh: 血把你从暗里标了出来。
lines.en: Blood marks you out from the dark.

lines.zh: 我不挑，凡是比我小的都算猎物。
lines.en: I am not choosy; anything smaller than me is prey.

lines.zh: 你落水的那一声，我等了很久。
lines.en: The splash of your fall—I waited long for it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过整个身体，对准你。
lines.en: I turn my whole body slowly to face you.

lines.zh: 这条船也是目标，你只是附带的。
lines.en: The boat is the target too; you come with it.

lines.zh: 一旦定了，我不会改。
lines.en: Once decided, I do not change my mind.

lines.zh: 我从下面上来，暗是我的掩护。
lines.en: I come up from below; the dark is my cover.

lines.zh: 你划得再快，也快不过这段距离。
lines.en: Row as fast as you like; the distance closes anyway.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底走，不激起水花。
lines.en: I travel along the floor without raising a splash.

lines.zh: 船在我眼里只是一块会浮的木。
lines.en: A boat is just a piece of floating wood to me.

lines.zh: 我每靠近一次，水就凉一点。
lines.en: Each time I near you, the water cools a little.

lines.zh: 你回头看，只会看见黑水。
lines.en: When you look back, you will see only black water.

lines.zh: 我算好了你换气的节拍。
lines.en: I have timed the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 我不声不响，慢慢抬高。
lines.en: I make no sound, rising slowly.

lines.zh: 你逃向浅处，我在那里等你。
lines.en: You flee to the shallows; I will be waiting there.

lines.zh: 我张嘴时，海水先退开。
lines.en: When I open my jaws, the sea pulls back.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，整条船断成两截。
lines.en: One bite, and the boat breaks in two.

lines.zh: 牙齿陷进去，像钉进软木。
lines.en: My teeth sink in like nails into cork.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把咬住的东西撕开。
lines.en: I thrash my head and tear loose what I hold.

lines.zh: 这一口有几千斤的力。
lines.en: There are thousands of pounds behind this bite.

lines.zh: 水被血染成暗红。
lines.en: The water stains a dark red.

lines.zh: 我咬断桅杆，帆落在海里。
lines.en: I bite through the mast; the sail falls into the sea.

lines.zh: 你抓住船沿，我咬住船沿。
lines.en: You hold the rail; I bite the rail.

lines.zh: 我退开，是为了从侧面再来。
lines.en: I retreat so I can come at you from the side.

lines.zh: 骨头在我嘴里像树枝。
lines.en: Bones in my mouth feel like twigs.

lines.zh: 咬完这一口，我沉回深处。
lines.en: After this bite, I sink back into the deep.

lines.zh: 我从海沟最深处浮上来，第一次见光。
lines.en: I rise from the deepest trench and see light.

lines.zh: 我的身长让这片海显得太浅。
lines.en: My length makes this sea seem too shallow.

lines.zh: 整个海床在我落下时震了一下。
lines.en: The whole seabed shakes when I land.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋裂开，先出来的是牙。
lines.en: The spawn egg splits; the teeth come out first.

lines.zh: 我在暗里长了几百年，才到这里。
lines.en: I grew for centuries in the dark to reach here.

lines.zh: 海水被我挤开，涌上了岸。
lines.en: The sea is displaced and floods the shore.

lines.zh: 一只巨齿鲨牙齿留在沙里，那是我的。
lines.en: A megalodon tooth lies in the sand; it is mine.

lines.zh: 从水桶里被倒出来，桶裂了。
lines.en: Poured from a bucket, the bucket splits.

lines.zh: 我第一次呼吸，吸进了一整片海。
lines.en: My first breath draws in a whole sea.

lines.zh: 远处有船，我朝那边去。
lines.en: There is a ship in the distance; I head for it.

lines.zh: 海水烧起来一样烫。
lines.en: The water burns as if it were aflame.

lines.zh: 我被拖上甲板，甲板塌了。
lines.en: Dragged onto the deck, the deck gives way.

lines.zh: 我在水里出生，却在这里窒息。
lines.en: I was born in water, and here I suffocate.

lines.zh: 冲击很小，可我还是晃了一下。
lines.en: The blast is small, but it still rocks me.

lines.zh: 箭扎在背上，像一根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back like a thorn.

lines.zh: 奇怪的力气钻进我的旧伤。
lines.en: A strange force crawls into my old wounds.

lines.zh: 饿上几个月，我也死不了。
lines.en: A few months of hunger will not kill me.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，海面全白了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back; the surface goes white.

lines.zh: 没有水的地方，我的骨头太重。
lines.en: Where there is no water, my bones are too heavy.
